usedFor: Zernio holds contacts and posts, and Google Contacts saves each new contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Zernio, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A contact created in Zernio is saved to your address book without retyping.

watchOut: “New Contact” in Zernio is polling within a window you choose, so match it to your check schedule.
